metadata.title: My Addresses — National Address Platform
metadata.description: My Addresses is an online tool that allows you to easily manage your addresses, from creating a Local Address Base to keeping it up to date.

home.title: My Addresses
home.subtitle: Manage your jurisdiction's addresses simply and efficiently.
home.searchPlaceholder: Filter local address bases by name
home.welcomeDescription: My Addresses is a free online tool that lets you create, manage, and publish your Local Address Base (LAB). No technical skills required.

publish.title: Publish your Local Address Base
publish.description: Publishing makes your addresses available in the National Address Platform.

newBase.title: Create a new Local Address Base
newBase.step1Description: Choose the state and county, then select a city or township or keep the county for unincorporated areas.
